environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer. The ALB security group allows inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. The container runs as root with /tmp as a shared writable volume across sidecar containers. Step Functions HTTP task integration calls the service endpoint directly. No network restrictions beyond standard VPC routing.

config.step_functions_integration: HTTP task with ALB DNS endpoint
